_about: Golden values for the rent-to-price calculator. Read by frontend/lib/__tests__/calculator.test.ts and backend/tests/test_calculator.py. 'jeff' and 'hand' are written by hand (the Buy vs Rent sheet and arithmetic done on paper); 'cross' holds parity anchors computed by the TypeScript implementation so Python cannot drift from it. Never regenerate 'jeff' or 'hand' from the code under test. The bisection stops at a residual of up to $0.50/month, which is $50-65 of price: 'cross' matches to the cent only if the server replicates the same midpoint sequence and stop rule (start at [0, 5000000], mid = (lo+hi)/2, |total-rent| < 0.5, 80 iterations, return lo on exhaustion); a 'better' bisection would be more precise and fail parity.
